name: Pippa Fernwhisker
lore: A red panda ribbon-weaver from Petalbrook Canopy. Pippa leaves warm tea for lost travelers and weaves living fern ribbons to protect her woodland home.

primary.name: Ribbon Stitch
primary.description: Send two intertwining living ribbons forward. Each deals 15 damage once; walls stop the weaving threads.

secondary.name: Fern Double
secondary.description: Grow a leaf double for 3 seconds to lure nearby enemies. It explodes for 24 damage within 150 units and slows drawn-in enemies for 3 seconds. It then pulses yellow, healing you and allies within 150 units for 8 HP each second for 3 seconds (24 total). Never heals enemies.

special.name: Maypole Waltz
special.description: Plant a maypole ahead. Three ribbon tips spiral outward over 2.4s to a 230-unit radius. Each tip hits each foe once for 36 and slows for 2s. Walls block the ribbons.

passive: Afterglow: allies healed by Fern Double also gain 20% movement speed for 2 seconds.

technique.name: Village Shelter
technique.description: Fern Double helps across a 30% wider radius, but explodes for 30% less damage.

final_technique.name: Fernfall Picnic
final_technique.description: Three fern stars bloom for 22 damage each and slow. Replaces the moving ribbon dance; no orbit or bonus travel.

attack.name: Fernfall Picnic
attack.description: Three fern stars bloom for 22 damage each and slow. Replaces the moving ribbon dance; no orbit or bonus travel.
